data.one_liner: A library to invoke and build CMake projects for Dart Native Assets.
data.what_it_does: Provides utilities to invoke and build CMake projects specifically for Dart Native Assets. Allows configuring CMake and Ninja versions, as well as Android NDK discovery through pubspec.yaml hooks.
use_when: You are building Dart Native Assets that require compiling a CMake project.
You need to configure custom CMake, Ninja, or Android NDK versions for your native builds via pubspec.yaml.
avoid_when: Your project does not use Dart Native Assets or CMake.
You want an established, stable toolchain library and wish to avoid experimental features.
strengths: Simplifies integrating CMake projects into Dart Native Assets workflows.
Supports fine-grained configuration for Android, iOS, Windows, Linux, and macOS in pubspec.yaml.
weaknesses: Explicitly marked as experimental and may change without warning.
Relies on external tools like CMake and Ninja being properly configured or discoverable.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring hooks and user defines in pubspec.yaml, along with having CMake and Ninja or appropriate NDK paths set up for target platforms.
